# Aadesh Kumar

Aadesh Kumar is a full-stack developer and AI & Automation Engineer based in Haridwar, India. This portfolio presents his professional experience and independent projects for hiring teams.

## Professional experience
- CIS IT Solutions (April 2025-present): Full-Stack Engineer; later also AI & Automations Engineer. Built frontends for Fesensi, Artisan and Nakshatra, plus CXScore360 across frontend and backend. Rebuilt the Fesensi backend for multi-tenancy under senior mentorship. Built RAG and API-backed agents for ticketing, astrology and commerce, and n8n content workflows.
- Perky Solutions (December 2024-March 2025): Junior Frontend Developer. Built dashboards and tables for more than 10,000 rows; reusable UI patterns reduced development time by 20%.
- Lostronaunt (August-October 2024): Market Analysis & Next.js Development Intern. Built an analytics dashboard with TypeScript, Prisma, MongoDB and NextAuth.

## Independent projects
- Japp Tattva (https://japptattva.com): Next.js commerce, admin and blog platform, plus a 109-node n8n content pipeline and Search Console-powered keyword engine. Search Console recorded 1.83K Web impressions and 17 clicks in 28 days.
- Decoded Person (https://decodedperson.com): Next.js and PostgreSQL news platform with 20-source RSS ingestion, LLM triage, fact validation and deduplication. Recorded 522 Google impressions and average position 8.1 in its first week.
- AI Script-to-Video Engine: Locally demonstrable Next.js project using OpenAI scripting and local Hugging Face image models.
